Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.hybrid

Class ReservoirStateProxy

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.hybrid.AbstractReservoirState
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.hybrid.ReservoirStateProxy
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, ReservoirStateModel, ReservoirDrive
public final class ReservoirStateProxy extends AbstractReservoirState implements ReservoirDrive
Tabulated reservoir-state proxy from one reservoir simulator run: reservoir pressure, water cut, gas-oil ratio, productivity index and optional wellstream composition as functions of one cumulative volume.

The table is built by post-processing Eclipse or OPM Flow summary results for a well or a drainage unit. Values are interpolated linearly in the abscissa and held constant outside the table; isOutsideValidity() then tells that a new simulator run is needed. The underlying assumption is that the reservoir state seen by the well is a function of the chosen cumulative volume only. That holds exactly for the simulator run the table came from and is an approximation for any other production strategy; use ScenarioReservoirState to interpolate between several runs.

The class also implements ReservoirDrive, so a simulator-derived pressure table can drive the existing IntegratedProductionModel.

1.0

  • Method Details

    • fromCsv

      public static ReservoirStateProxy fromCsv(String name, CumulativeQuantity abscissaQuantity, Path file) throws IOException
      Reads a proxy from a comma-separated file.

      The first non-comment line is a header. Recognised columns (case-insensitive): cumulative (required), pressure (required), waterCut, gor, pi, molesPerSm3, a cumulative quantity name such as WATER_INJECTED, and z:<component> for composition columns. Lines starting with # are ignored.

      Parameters:
      name - name of the well or drainage unit
      abscissaQuantity - cumulative volume of the cumulative column
      file - file to read
      Returns:
      the proxy
      Throws:
      IOException - if the file cannot be read
      IllegalArgumentException - if a required column is missing or a value is not a number

    • produce

      public void produce(double producedVolumeSm3, double dtDays)
      Advances the drive by producing a volume over a time step.

      The volume is added to the abscissa quantity of the table. An oil or water increment also advances total liquid production, including any liquid-only production history.

      Specified by:
      produce in interface ReservoirDrive
      Parameters:
      producedVolumeSm3 - surface volume produced during the step in Sm3
      dtDays - length of the time step in days
